title: Prove an exact involutive Walsh lift of the historical selected complex supplier
body:
This enabling proof replaces the historical selected complex supplier's frames with exact involutive Walsh frames. For each old rank-r frame, `Gamma_V = i^-r (H_V tensor H_V)` satisfies `Gamma_V^2 = I` on arbitrary arrays. The actual routed centre queries then admit complementary factors whose cross-stage product is zero. This removes a coefficient-field obstruction to a reusable centre encoder.

The [proof and finite invoice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/PROOF.md), [centre application](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/CENTRE-APPLICATION.md), [complete replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/evidence/REPLAY.json), and [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. The [native proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/NATIVE-PROOF.md) and [global binding](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/GLOBAL-WALSH.md) establish the implementation interfaces.

The construction doubles the ambient dimension from 73 to 146 and every recursive child rank. It retains the 14336 productive families, complete borrowed-helper jobs, invocation order, owner assignment, and diagonal cover-group order. Its paid rank mass is 2082816 and its rank deficit is 10240. Every normalized recursive rank ratio is unchanged, so the pure complex moment and complete kappa calculation do not improve. The twofold lift passes the complete retained finite guards, including the 512-bit prefix and 48-bit local primitive bound. The fourfold comparison fails the local primitive guard.

The exact base and consumed dependency commit is `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. The input is the [historical PR #1094 selection receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1094-audit/ASSEMBLY.json), not a claim about today's selected frontier. The proof retains the all-size native, compiler, whole-call hosting, precision, fixed-tape, and analytic recurrence assumptions. The replay emits local native factors and a complete global operator schedule; it does not flatten an all-size instruction tape or prove the full multiplication theorem. Legal decoder access, changed-word mode hosting, and the complete cost of a cheaper centre supplier remain open.

From the repository root, with Python 3.10 or later, Git, and the pinned source commit present, run:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/involutive-walsh-lift/verify.py
```

The expected final line is:

```text
PASS_INVOLUTIVE_WALSH_LIFT_PACKAGE
```

All seven stages passed, including cold replays into fresh output directories. Separate research agents checked the proofs and wrote independent exact reviewers. Coverage includes 1004 full frame adapters, 2896 full child operators, 224 endpoints, 36 helper normalizers, all 712 scalar input columns in both orientations, all 144 selected calls, 69120 complete helper jobs, 7526 idle suffixes, and 14336 productive endpoints. Negative controls reject a missing scalar phase, the singular even-line formula, a wrong helper route, a missing helper job, an incorrect bridge sign, and stale terminal or cover translations. Two exact rational moment engines agree. The final staged source and artifact hashes match the replay. Source assertions are required; do not run the driver with `-O`. The old frontier admission target was not rerun or modified. Independent human review has not yet occurred.

The [source notices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ae9a6f3ac74ded022ab3b4872a7357a621af6fb/research/involutive-walsh-lift/NOTICE.md) preserve the full lineage. The consumed local word and gauge are credited to @icekylinx in the [gauge44 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots/NOTICE.md); the 16-replica assembly is credited to Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) in the [t16 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/t16/NOTICE.md). The owner exchanges and invoice use @rohanarun's [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094), whose [source README](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/README.md) also credits Jeremy Kothe (@jeremykothe2) for [PR #1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087). Earlier author and license notices remain intact. New research, code, and verification used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance under the user's direction. New material uses the repository's Apache-2.0 license.
